column_description: BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, uniquely identifying each air-quality reading record.
BIGINT FOREIGN KEY referencing EnvironmentalReadingsCore(EnvReadRegistry). Links this record to its main environmental reading.
SMALLINT measuring CO2 concentration in parts per million (ppm). Typical range: 300–2000.
INT capturing total volatile organic compounds in parts per billion (ppb).
INT indicating ozone concentration in ppb.
SMALLINT for sulfur dioxide concentration in ppb.
BIGINT for nitrogen dioxide concentration in ppb.
REAL measuring particulate matter (PM2.5) in µg/m³ or a similar metric.
NUMERIC(5,2) measuring PM10 concentration, possibly µg/m³ as well.
NUMERIC(7,4) for formaldehyde (HCHO) concentration (e.g., mg/m³ or another scale).
NUMERIC(4,1) indicating air exchange rate (e.g., air changes per hour).
NUMERIC(5,2) capturing air velocity in meters per second (m/s).
